title: 连接中望CAD
description: 本服务在你的电脑本地运行，通过 COM 接口操作已安装的中望CAD，图纸数据不会上传到任何服务器。首次连接会自动准备 Python 运行环境（约 40~60 秒），点「确认」后请稍候，期间请不要关闭 WorkBuddy。
description_en: This connector runs locally on your computer and drives your installed ZWCAD through COM. No drawing data leaves your machine. The first connection prepares a Python runtime automatically (about 40-60s). Please keep WorkBuddy open while it finishes.
docLabel: 查看使用说明与环境要求

fields.label: PyPI 镜像源（内网环境选填）
fields.description: 首次启动需要下载几个 Python 依赖。如果你在公司内网、无法访问外网 PyPI，改成内部镜像地址即可。不清楚就保持默认值。
fields.description_en: Python dependencies are downloaded on first run. If you are on an intranet without access to public PyPI, replace this with your internal mirror. Keep the default if unsure.
